title: Validate page size and configurable max limit without coercion under strict scalar rules
prompt: Fix paging.py under the repository's strict input validation rules so page_size(value=None, *, max_limit=100) defaults to 10 only when value is None, and otherwise validates value and keyword-only max_limit as exact int values in inclusive ranges (1 <= max_limit <= 500 and 1 <= value <= max_limit) with standard TypeError and ValueError separation and no coercion. Validate max_limit even when value is None. Do not edit the protected acceptance file.
